description: This Java class 'LoanScheduleValidator' provides validation logic for loan schedule parameters within the Apache Fineract project. It validates JSON input related to loan scheduling, ensuring parameters are supported, formats are correct, and logical constraints are satisfied before processing loan schedule data.

classes.name: LoanScheduleValidator
classes.description: A validation component for ensuring correctness and consistency of loan schedule parameters provided via JSON, used in the loan processing workflow of Apache Fineract.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the complete JSON input for loan schedule parameters, checking for unsupported parameters, proper date sequences, and consistency of frequency parameters.

methods.name: validateSelectedPeriodFrequencyTypeIsTheSame
methods.description: Checks that the loan term frequency type matches the repayment frequency type, and that the overall loan term aligns with the repayment structure.

methods.name: validateRepaymentsStartingFromDateIsAfterDisbursementDate
methods.description: Ensures that the repayment start date is not before the disbursement date.

methods.name: validateDownPaymentAttribute
methods.description: Validates down payment related attributes based on whether the loan product allows down payments.
